info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Trade Banking By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to modify specific parameters of trade banking bank guarantees. By using the PATCH method, clients can update existing bank guarantee details based on the provided identifier (param1). Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and banking software providers seeking to dynamically manage trade-related banking guarantees. This capability helps streamline operations and enhance the management of banking products.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific bank guarantee identified by its resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request body to modify the existing bank guarantee information effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the bank guarantee resource identified by RES-100045. This should include the necessary fields that specify the updates to be applied to the bank guarantee.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
